Build a quality-layer observation table

cl_qa_obs.Rd

Reads each scene's producer quality layer (Landsat QA_PIXEL, Sentinel-2 SCL) over the requested grid cells and records, for every cell-observation, the share of valid pixels flagged as cloud, cloud shadow and snow. Scene-level cloud cover is an average over a footprint of 10,000 km2 or more and says little about a particular cell; this table measures the cell itself. It is the "qa" evidence tier and can be passed to every function that accepts a cl_obs table.

A scene contributes to the cells whose centroid lies within its footprint, as in cl_items_to_obs. Pixels are classified with cl_qa_decode; a pixel flagged as both cloud and shadow counts as cloud. Tiles acquired within overpass_minutes of each other are one observation of a cell, and the tile with the most valid pixels in the cell is kept. Landsat assets that the catalogue lists in the requester-pays USGS bucket are read from the Planetary Computer mirror with an anonymous access token.

Usage

cl_qa_obs(items, grid, cells, include_cirrus = TRUE, confidence = "medium",
  overpass_minutes = 20, workers = 1L)

Arguments

items

Scenes from cl_search.

grid

A grid from cl_grid.

cells

Cell identifiers to evaluate.

include_cirrus

Passed to cl_qa_decode.

confidence

Passed to cl_qa_decode.

overpass_minutes

Tiles acquired within this many minutes are one overpass.

workers

Scenes read in parallel by forked processes; forced to 1 on Windows.

Value

A cl_obs table of tier "qa". cloud_fraction, shadow_fraction and snow_fraction are shares of the valid pixels in the cell; valid_fraction is the share of the cell with valid data, n_valid the number of valid pixels and id the scene kept. Cell-observations without valid pixels are dropped. Attribute "failed" holds the identifiers of scenes that could not be read.
